confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Brazilian prices are set in BRL and converted to USD at an assumed rate. July is Brazil's school-holiday peak, so the hostel and hotel anchors are set toward high-season levels and are the least certain. Restaurant anchors are more reliable. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rate page; I did not independently confirm it against the RBA F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Brazilian interior tourism hubs, with a premium for Iguazu Falls visitor demand. Restaurant and café anchors reflect ordinary local venues rather than waterfront or hotel venues. Cocktail and wine anchors come from direct knowledge of local bar pricing, not from beer.
